messages:
Riley: Quick idea: build a small 'trace-snap' in the console to capture a short-lived high-fidelity request/response for a route. Goal: help debug nondeterministic failures without permanent high-volume logging. Want thoughts before I RFC.

Kiran: Sounds useful. What are the safety knobs? who can start it?

Riley: UI: click 'Trace-snap' on a route -> short reason -> TTL options (5/10/30m) -> optional filter by trace_id or user. Server checks sensitivity classifier and either permits or queues for approval. Default: internal dev roles only.

Marta: Ops: must have per-tenant token cap (suggest 25k tokens / 10m) and route cooldown (30m). Also require a live token meter and automatic fallback to metadata-only if ingestion pressure high.

Priya: Legal: require ticket link and mandatory justification. If classifier flags PII then require legal approver. Raw data retention maximum 6h, encrypted, with auditable access. No raw exports without approvals.

Riley: Implementation: trace-snap sets header x-rdw-trace-snap:<id>. Ingress marks samples to skip normal sampling but always run redaction. Redaction cannot be bypassed.

Kiran: API sketch:
POST /internal/v1/trace-snap
{route, requestor, ttl_secs, filter, ticket, enforce_budget:true}

Marta: Add max_tokens_estimate and rollout_tag. Also add an emergency global cutoff that auto-cancels new snaps when overall capture burn > 80%. ops-bot should alert earlier.

ops-bot: [sim-alert] Projected trace-snap token burn hitting 72% for tenant acme in 8m.

Priya: Make sure classifier runs server-side; console only shows the result. Record approver roles and timestamps in audit.

Riley: Rollout: internal dev tenants only -> 2-week canary -> expose per-route opt-in for customer tenants. RFC will include fallback matrix: full -> p95-bodies -> headers only.

Kiran: Also add GET /internal/v1/trace-snap/<id>/audit for exportable audit records (justification, approvers, token usage, links if allowed).

Marta: +1 but ops wants adjustable per-tenant caps and realtime knob to throttle.

Priya: +1 pending RFC with legal checklist.

Riley: Thanks, will draft RFC and mock console tomorrow.
